name: שִׁפְרָה
summary: One of the two Hebrew midwives who feared God and would not kill the boys at the king of Egypt's command, and to whom God gave houses. Her name is spelled exactly like the noun שִׁפְרָה, 'fairness', which Job uses for the heavens made fair by God's breath. It comes from the root of 'be pleasing, beautiful'.

evidence.note: The name of the one was שִׁפְרָה, and the name of the second was פּוּעָה.
The same word as a noun: by his breath the heavens are שִׁפְרָה, fairness.
The root's verb: the inheritance שָׁפְרָה, is beautiful, to me. The same letters as her name.

note: BDB lists Exo 1:15 under both the name (v.fm.ae) and the noun (v.fm.ad); this entry takes the name's key. Her story is Exo 1:15–21.
